LanguageData.RavenPlace_TangGu.label: [Raven] Tanggu
LanguageData.RavenPlace_TangGu.description: A sacred valley where Raven Golden Crows roost. It is the legendary birthplace of the rising sun.
LanguageData.RavenPlace_YangGu.label: [Raven] Yanggu
LanguageData.RavenPlace_YangGu.description: An ancient holy site of the Raven Golden Crows. Legends say it is the bathing place of the morning sun.
LanguageData.RavenPlace_FusangTree.label: [Raven] Fusang Tree
LanguageData.RavenPlace_FusangTree.description: A colossal tree that serves as a passage between heaven and earth. A holy site for the Raven Golden Crows.
LanguageData.RavenPlace_RuoTree.label: [Raven] Ruo Tree
LanguageData.RavenPlace_RuoTree.description: A colossal tree marking the western edge of the world. It is the endpoint of the Raven Golden Crow's daily journey, where the evening sun sinks beneath its canopy.
LanguageData.RavenPlace_SunPalace.label: [Raven] Sun Palace
LanguageData.RavenPlace_SunPalace.description: The palace of the Raven Golden Crow Emperor, located at the highest peak of the sky.
LanguageData.RavenPlace_XianChi.label: [Raven] Xianchi Pool
LanguageData.RavenPlace_XianChi.description: A solar bathhouse in the sky where Raven Golden Crows wash away mortal dust every patrol.
LanguageData.RavenPlace_YanZi.label: [Raven] Mount Yanzi
LanguageData.RavenPlace_YanZi.description: The mountain of sunset. Raven Golden Crows sink here into the west every day, spreading twilight across the world.
LanguageData.RavenPlace_ShadowValley.label: [Raven] Shadow Valley
LanguageData.RavenPlace_ShadowValley.description: A traditional settlement of the Raven faction, hidden deep within the mountain shadows.
LanguageData.RavenPlace_EmberShrine.label: [Raven] Ember Shrine
LanguageData.RavenPlace_EmberShrine.description: A shrine dedicated to the embers of the Raven Golden Crow, where Ravens conduct their dark rituals.
